narrative_engine.thesis: trend down regime (H4 stack down · D1 stack down · EMA spread -5.60 ATR · price holds below Day VWAP), but price sits 2.35σ from the Day VWAP — chasing here pays no edge. Working limit order at the trend-side band 1542.18-1559.94; the offer is earned when footprint absorption or a strong divergence prints at the zone.

plan.triggerRule: limit fill at the zone + bearish footprint confirmation (absorption / strong divergence / trap)
vetoes: chase guard: > 2.0σ VWAP extension — wait for the pullback

athena_oracle.verdict: Strong bearish confluence 26/100 — trend broken, flow fading, liq magnets below
